public.description_short: Custom printed replacement top for a 10x10 40 mm hex-frame pop-up canopy, finished 117.6 x 117.6 in.
public.description_long: The 10x10 Pop-Up Canopy Tent Top is a custom printed replacement top for a 10x10 pop-up canopy built on a 40 mm hex frame. It is a single printed canopy-top surface with a finished footprint of 117.6 x 117.6 in. Artwork should be supplied at a minimum of 50 dpi at final size. This registry entry covers the printed top only; corner radius and safe zone are not yet published for this SKU.

internal.notes: Finished dimensions of 117.6 x 117.6 in are taken from the HBS-12569 reference. That same reference also calls out a 17 in valance, and the 117.6 in dimension runs edge-to-edge across the bottom valance rather than across the flat top panel alone. Factory geometry should remain authoritative; if the factory template disagrees with the reference, the factory template wins. safe_zone_in is null pending factory-template measurement, and corner_radius_in does not apply as measured. dpi_floor of 50 is the current sewn-fabric preflight floor, not a SKU-specific value. sides is SS because this is a single printed canopy-top surface, not a double-sided panel. wide_format is false given the square footprint. Source file name: 10x10_40_MM_HEX_UnBranded Specs_Top.ai. default_substrate is null because no substrate has been explicitly confirmed. Pricing never comes from this registry and the PO remains the source of truth. ordant_product_id is not yet assigned.
